app.name: bankKhana
app.setupBody: Copy .env.example to .env, add your project URL and anon key, then restart the app.

offline.banner: You are offline. Viewing saved data. New expenses will sync when you reconnect.
offline.actionDisabled: Connect to the internet to use this
offline.needCache: Connect once online to load your data, then you can view it offline.
offline.pageUnavailable: This section needs a network connection for live prices or trading.

auth.error: Could not sign in. Please check your credentials and try again.
auth.signupOk: Account created. Check your email if confirmation is required, then sign in.

expense.empty: No expenses yet. Add your first one.

dashboard.emptyChart: Add expenses this month to see charts.
dashboard.wealthEmpty: Add accounts, gold, or stocks to see this chart.
dashboard.summaryHelp: Your money across accounts, gold, and stocks.

settings.defaultCurrencyHelp: Dashboard totals use this currency. When you spend from another currency, enter what it equals in this one.
settings.installBody: Add bankKhana to your home screen. Offline you can view saved accounts and expenses, and queue new expenses to sync when you are back online.
settings.installIos: On iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
settings.installAndroid: On Android Chrome: open the menu, then Install app or Add to Home screen.

gold.title: Gold
gold.subtitle: Track grams by karat. Value uses your gram prices in Settings.
gold.buyHint: Pay from an account using your gram prices in Settings.
gold.formHint: Record gold you already own. This does not take money from an account.
gold.priceUnavailable: Could not load gold prices from the API. Enter them manually.
gold.pricesHelp: Price per gram in {{currency}} for 24K, 21K, and 18K. Loaded from the market API; you can edit them.
gold.transferHint: Convert grams to money using your gram prices, then add it to an account.
gold.setPricesFirst: Set gold prices in Settings (or tap Refresh) to value holdings and sell to an account.
gold.insufficient: Not enough grams in this holding.

accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add a wallet, cash, or bank account.
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.editHint: Change the name, currency, or balance.
accounts.insufficient: Not enough money in this account.
accounts.needAccountFirst: Create an account first, then add expenses from it.
accounts.addMoneyHint: Add to this account in its currency.
accounts.transferHint: Move money between accounts. Different currencies convert automatically.
accounts.needTwoAccounts: Add a second account to transfer.
accounts.cannotDelete: This account has expenses. Delete those expenses first.

stocks.egyptHint: Egyptian prices come from the EGX feed (TradingView), in EGP — not Yahoo. Use COMI, HRHO, SWDY.
stocks.formHint: Ticker, how many shares you hold, and the average price you paid.
stocks.tradeHint: Uses the live market price, then converts to the account currency.
stocks.quoteUnavailable: Could not load a live price for this ticker. For Egypt use codes like COMI, HRHO, or COMI.CA.
